ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: Page rendered inside ErrorBoundary. Root cause: `import { t } from '@/lib/i18n'` (line 9) is shadowed by `const { t } = useI18n()` (line 15), but `usePageMeta({ title: `${t('payments')} · BEVID` })` on line 13 references the shadowed identifier → 'ReferenceError: Cannot access `t` before initialization' (TDZ). Fix: rename static import to `tStatic` OR compute title inside effect after hook.

critical_code_review_comments: Paiements.jsx: `import { t } from '@/lib/i18n'` + `const { t } = useI18n()` creates a `const` variable shadow with a same-name reference in `usePageMeta` above the redeclaration → guaranteed TDZ. Any linter with `no-shadow`/`no-use-before-define` would catch it. Recommend an ESLint rule to block this pattern project-wide.
Layout.jsx: single `<h1>` per document is a WCAG best practice; the sidebar brand should not use <h1> — reserve for page main heading.
Reports/AdminUsers/Confidentialite tables: inconsistent mobile-scroll implementation. Extract a `<ResponsiveTable>` wrapper enforcing min-width + sticky first col to avoid drift.
Frontend HTTP response headers appear to be set by a different middleware than /api — keep them in sync (single source of truth for security headers).

rca_of_the_issue.paiements_TDZ: In Paiements.jsx: line 9 `import { t } from '@/lib/i18n'` brings a module-scope `t`. Line 15 `const { t } = useI18n()` DECLARES a block-scope const named `t`. In JS, once `const t` is declared in a block, ALL references to `t` in that block resolve to it — including line 13 which executes BEFORE line 15. Result: ReferenceError (TDZ). Fix: `import { t as tStatic } from '@/lib/i18n'` and use `tStatic('payments')` on line 13; OR move the title binding to a useEffect after the hook.
